Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. We confirmed the exec workshop at Marriott Union Square for Sep 22–24 (approx. 120 attendees, 40 room-nights). Two quick asks as we finalize the masterbill and arrival logistics: 

1) Can Marriott accept a direct-bill for the master account (billing to Redwood Inference) and what paperwork do you need from procurement (W9, PO, company ACH details)? If there are corporate forms we need to upload, please point me to them.

2) On arrival day (Sep 22) we will have a staggered guest arrival window between 9:00–13:30. We need a single on-site liaison / contact at the hotel (name and mobile) to coordinate late arrivals and key drop for a small VIP subset (4 rooms). Will that be possible?

I attached a quick master-bill request template we use to kick things off. I can also provide a restricted arrival manifest once names are finalized.

Thanks — hope you have a good Friday.

—Karthik

Hi Karthik —

Great to hear — we have availability and can set up direct billing to Redwood Inference. For corporate direct bill we generally need the following: 
- Completed Direct Bill Authorization Form (attached: Marriott_DirectBill_Form.pdf)
- Copy of company W9 (or W8 for foreign entities)
- Billing contact and PO (if Redwood uses POs)

I can serve as the on-site liaison for arrival day; my cell is +1 415-777-4433. For the VIP rooms we recommend preloading keycards and adding a "Do Not Disturb—Hold at Front Desk" note on the reservation so keys are available for express pick-up.

Couple of operational notes: 
- There is a $1,500 incidental hold per VIP room at check-in if guests use a credit card; if we are direct-billing room and incidentals to corporate, we can waive or move that to express check-in with event billing.
- Please send the final arrival manifest 72 hours prior (we'll confirm rooming and key instructions at that time).

I attached the direct-bill form. Once we have the W9 and your master-bill template completed we will forward to our accounting to begin the setup (this typically takes 3–5 business days).

Best,
Samira Patel
